suite.doc: Throughput across the SRv6 core, measured with iperf3 between the Alpine tenant hosts: the shortest path, a steered path (one uSID carrier segment) and the same steered path as an uncompressed three-segment SRH. The numbers are what a 1 vCPU VyOS software data plane over UDP-tunnelled links gives (~100-150 Mbit/s); the test asserts a floor and that steering / uSID do not break or collapse throughput. Policies are removed.
